description: This file defines an enumeration 'XSmoothingMode' which specifies different modes of smoothing or anti-aliasing options used in drawing operations within the PDFsharp library. It includes several modes like Default, HighSpeed, HighQuality, None, and AntiAlias, with associated integer values.

classes.name: XSmoothingMode
classes.description: An enumeration that indicates how smoothing or anti-aliasing is applied to lines and curves in PDF rendering.
